acceptance_criteria.description: Inputs identify a provider-neutral locator and credential names without persisting credential values or authenticated URLs.
Every materialization uses a fresh non-overwriting root and rejects traversal or duplicate destinations.
Report, index, manifest, evidence, and referenced artifacts pass exact SHA-256 and size checks before ledger invocation.
Explicit absolute-prefix relocation maps are supported and retained without publishing machine-private paths.
Unavailable, unauthorized, partial, malformed, or drifted content cannot create metric rows or claim eligibility.
One legally public historical candidate is materialized end to end or closed with an exact license or provenance blocker.

objective: Fetch explicitly configured historical benchmark artifacts into fresh isolated roots, verify every byte and relocation before ledger ingestion, and fail closed without leaking credentials or promoting unverified summaries.
title: Materialize external benchmark evidence for the ledger
